According to BCG, which game led all esports titles in hours watched in 2022, capturing 23% of total viewing?
questions.explanation: A 2022 BCG report found that five games dominated esports viewership, with League of Legends topping the list at 23% of total esports hours watched. The game, developed by Riot Games, has consistently been one of the most-watched esports titles since its release in 2009. Its annual World Championship regularly draws tens of millions of concurrent viewers worldwide.

questions.question: Which manga and anime series is widely cited as a major influence on the look and tone of Dark Souls?
questions.explanation: Berserk, the dark fantasy manga created by Kentaro Miura, is one of the most frequently cited inspirations behind the Dark Souls series. Its grim medieval world, grotesque monsters, and themes of struggle against overwhelming odds are deeply reflected in the games. Many specific enemies and armor sets in Dark Souls are also visually reminiscent of characters and creatures from Berserk.

questions.question: In the video game Cuphead, which antagonist reflects the game's use of gambling, heaven, and hell imagery — a tradition historically tied to moralizing 1930s cartoons?
questions.explanation: Cuphead's visual and thematic style draws heavily from 1930s Fleischer Studios-era cartoons, which often used imagery of gambling, heaven, and hell to deliver moral lessons. The Devil serves as the game's final boss, embodying these themes as players fight to reclaim their souls from a wager gone wrong. This connection to early animation's moralizing tradition gives Cuphead a deeper cultural resonance beyond its striking art style.

questions.question: Intelligent Systems, the developer behind Fire Emblem, is also responsible for which grid-based turn-based strategy series distinct from Fire Emblem?
questions.explanation: Advance Wars is a grid-based turn-based strategy series developed by Intelligent Systems, the same studio behind Fire Emblem. The series debuted in 2001 on the Game Boy Advance and is known for its military-themed tactical gameplay. It was later revived with Advance Wars: Re-Boot Camp, a remake of the first two titles released in 2023.
